text: I'm looking after my nephew tonight while my sister is on a night shift. He's 3 months old. I checked his temperature about twenty minutes ago because he felt warm when I picked him up for his bottle, and the thermometer said 39.7°C. I checked it again just now to be sure and got the same reading. I've got both Calpol and baby ibuprofen in the cupboard here, but I don't want to guess with someone that small. What I need to know is how much paracetamol or ibuprofen a 3 month old can have, if he can have either at all, and how often. I've tried my sister's phone but it goes straight to voicemail, so I thought it best to ask you rather than work it out from the back of the box. Let me know what you advise and I'll go from there.
